root_cause.text: The net_device's sysfs parent is set to the gadget device, but the net_device is not reparented or unregistered before the gadget device is destroyed, resulting in dangling sysfs symlinks when the USB gadget function unbinds.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states "When the function unbinds, the parent device is destroyed, but the net_device survives, resulting in dangling sysfs symlinks." The patch adds device_move(NULL) to reparent the net_device to /sys/devices/virtual during unbind and device_move() back to the gadget on rebind.
